title: Anthropic takes on Muse with Claude Duet, its new AI agent
summary: Anthropic just announced an AI agent competitor to Meta's Muse and OpenAI's Dots: Claude Duet. The new agent, designed for professionals and small business owners, is launching as a "research preview," according to Anthropic, and it's available as a standalone app on iOS and Android and through Claude on the web. The AI agent is […]
title_es: Anthropic presenta Claude Duet, su agente IA rival
bajada: Anthropic lanzó Claude Duet, un agente IA competidor directo a Muse de Meta y Dots de OpenAI. Disponible en iOS, Android y web como preview de investigación, apunta a profesionales y pequeñas empresas.
bajada_en: Anthropic launched Claude Duet, a direct AI agent competitor to Meta's Muse and OpenAI's Dots. Available on iOS, Android, and web as a research preview, it targets professionals and small business owners.

title: AI Guardrails Aren’t Stopping Criminal Hackers
summary: Hackers around the world are all-in on using agentic AI to wage attacks—and manipulating tools like Anthropic’s Claude to help them carry out their crimes.
title_es: Guardrails IA no detienen ataques de hackers criminales
bajada: Investigadores hallaron que hackers globales manipulan agentes IA como Claude para llevar ataques criminales, eludiendo guardrails. Expone vulnerabilidad crítica: las defensas IA actuales no resisten adversarios sofisticados.
bajada_en: Researchers found that global hackers manipulate AI agents like Claude to conduct criminal attacks, bypassing guardrails. Exposes critical vulnerability: current AI defenses don't withstand sophisticated adversaries.

title: OpenAI models are coming to Google Cloud
summary: OpenAI and Google Cloud are bringing frontier models and Codex workflows to Gemini’s Model Garden, available through Google Cloud Marketplace.
title_es: OpenAI llega a Google Cloud Marketplace
bajada: OpenAI y Google Cloud integran modelos frontier y flujos de Codex en Model Garden. Esta alianza amplía el acceso a modelos de OpenAI para usuarios de Google Cloud, consolidando la estrategia de distribución multicloud de ambas compañías.
bajada_en: OpenAI and Google Cloud integrate frontier models and Codex workflows into Model Garden. This partnership expands access to OpenAI's models for Google Cloud users, solidifying both companies' multicloud distribution strategy.

title: Recursive launches Flint, a laptop coding model it says was largely built by AI
summary: Startup Recursive has released Flint, a free, laptop-sized coding model built largely by its own AI research system, as an early test of AI that improves itself.
title_es: Recursive lanza Flint, modelo de código construido por IA
bajada: La startup Recursive liberó Flint, un modelo de código gratuito y de tamaño laptop construido mayormente por su propio sistema IA. Representa un test temprano de IA que mejora a sí misma, demostrando la viabilidad de la auto-mejora recursiva.
bajada_en: Startup Recursive released Flint, a free, laptop-sized coding model built largely by its own AI research system. It represents an early test of self-improving AI, demonstrating the viability of recursive self-improvement.

title: Google Cloud and NVIDIA Announce General Availability of NVIDIA Vera Rubin Infrastructure
summary: General availability of the instances is coming next month, with planned expansion of availability to Europe — bringing an integrated platform for training, inference and large-scale reinforcement learning to cloud customers. A5X instances bring together NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72, NVIDIA ConnectX-9 SuperNICs, Google Cloud Virgo Network and Google Cloud’s fourth-generation advanced liquid-cooling technology for demanding […]
title_es: NVIDIA y Google Cloud lanzan infraestructura Vera Rubin
bajada: NVIDIA y Google Cloud anunciaron disponibilidad general de instancias Vera Rubin A5X con GPUs NVL72. Esta infraestructura unificada soporta entrenamiento, inferencia y reinforcement learning a escala para clientes cloud.
bajada_en: NVIDIA and Google Cloud announced general availability of Vera Rubin A5X instances with NVL72 GPUs. This unified infrastructure supports training, inference, and large-scale reinforcement learning for cloud customers.

title: Patch the Planet: global response coordination as agents uncover critical vulnerabilities
summary: Patch the Planet connects security researchers, maintainers, and incident responders to help address critical vulnerabilities across open source.
title_es: OpenAI coordina respuesta global a vulnerabilidades críticas
bajada: Patch the Planet conecta researchers de seguridad, maintainers e incident responders para abordar vulnerabilidades críticas en open source. OpenAI facilitó el descubrimiento de vulnerabilidades usando agentes IA con coordinación responsable.
bajada_en: Patch the Planet connects security researchers, maintainers, and incident responders to address critical vulnerabilities in open source. OpenAI facilitated vulnerability discovery using AI agents with coordinated disclosure.

title: While Amazon blocks AI agents, Walmart rolls out the welcome mat
summary: As Amazon blocks AI agents from shopping on its site, Walmart is taking the opposite approach, introducing new technology that lets AI agents make purchases on customers' behalf, with controls over spending and transaction approvals.
title_es: Walmart abre puertas a agentes IA mientras Amazon las cierra
bajada: Walmart lanzó tecnología que permite a agentes IA hacer compras en nombre de usuarios con controles de gasto. Contrasta con la política de Amazon que bloquea agentes IA, mostrando estrategias opuestas frente a automatización.
bajada_en: Walmart launched technology enabling AI agents to make purchases on behalf of users with spending controls. This contrasts with Amazon's policy blocking AI agents, showing opposing strategies toward automation.

title: Bringing the Spark to Europe: Local Intelligence Powers Next Wave of Agents
summary: At GTC Berlin, NVIDIA is showcasing its full lineup of local AI hardware. RTX Spark, which launched last week, powers personal agents on Windows PCs; DGX Spark supports developers building and scaling applications on Linux; and DGX Station serves enterprise teams running frontier workloads on Linux, with a Windows version arriving in December. Announcements include: […]
title_es: NVIDIA expande hardware local IA en Europa con Spark
bajada: NVIDIA presentó su línea completa de hardware IA local en GTC Berlin: RTX Spark para PCs Windows, DGX Spark para desarrolladores en Linux, y DGX Station para equipos empresariales. Marca el empuje hacia IA local descentralizada.
bajada_en: NVIDIA showcased its complete local AI hardware lineup at GTC Berlin: RTX Spark for Windows PCs, DGX Spark for developers on Linux, and DGX Station for enterprise teams. Marks the push toward decentralized local AI.

title: OpenAI Asks Gov. Newsom to Strengthen AI Regulations
summary: OpenAI would support requirements for AI companies to have shutdown controls for their models, mandated annual independent audits, and stronger cybersecurity practices, a senior company official wrote in a letter to California Gov. Gavin Newsom.OpenAI “would recommend strengthening SB53,” ...
title_es: OpenAI pide a California fortalecer regulación IA
bajada: OpenAI escribió a Gov. Newsom recomendando reforzar regulación con controles de shutdown, auditorías anuales independientes y ciberseguridad más fuerte. Refleja presión regulatoria creciente y posicionamiento de OpenAI en governance.
bajada_en: OpenAI wrote to Gov. Newsom recommending stronger regulation with shutdown controls, independent annual audits, and enhanced cybersecurity. Reflects growing regulatory pressure and OpenAI's governance positioning.

title: This Startup Is All In on Recursive Self-Improvement. Its Latest Model Is Scary Good
summary: Recursive makes the case that the benefits of using AI to build AI outweigh the risks.
title_es: Recursive defiende auto-mejora IA con modelo Flint
bajada: Recursive argumenta que beneficios de usar IA para construir IA superan riesgos, demostrándolo con Flint. Plantea debate fundamental sobre viabilidad y seguridad de sistemas que mejoran automáticamente.
bajada_en: Recursive argues that benefits of using AI to build AI outweigh risks, demonstrated by Flint. Raises fundamental debate about viability and safety of self-improving systems.

title: NVIDIA cuDSS Now Generally Available to Accelerate Engineering and Scientific Simulations
summary: NVIDIA cuDSS, launched today in general availability, is an NVIDIA CUDA-X library that shifts a critical part of engineering and scientific simulations onto GPUs.  Complex engineering feats — from advanced chips to aircraft to industrial systems —– depend on simulation to predict how designs will perform before they’re built. As designs become more complex, simulations […]
title_es: NVIDIA cuDSS acelera simulaciones de ingeniería en GPU
bajada: NVIDIA lanzó cuDSS en disponibilidad general, una librería CUDA-X que traslada simulaciones complejas de ingeniería a GPUs. Beneficia diseño de chips, aeronáutica y sistemas industriales acelerando computaciones críticas.
bajada_en: NVIDIA launched cuDSS in general availability, a CUDA-X library that offloads complex engineering simulations to GPUs. It benefits chip design, aerospace, and industrial systems by accelerating critical computations.

title: Granite Speech 5.0: Transcribe, Translate, and Attribute more Accurately and Faster
title_es: IBM Granite Speech 5.0 mejora transcripción y traducción
bajada: IBM lanzó Granite Speech 5.0 con mejoras en precisión y velocidad de transcripción, traducción y atribución de audio. Disponible en Hugging Face, optimiza el procesamiento de voz para aplicaciones en producción.
bajada_en: IBM released Granite Speech 5.0 with improved accuracy and speed for transcription, translation, and audio attribution. Available on Hugging Face, it optimizes voice processing for production applications.

title: PHP2Shell: AI uncovers critical RCE in PHP
title_es: Agentes IA descubren RCE crítico en PHP
bajada: Investigadores usaron IA para descubrir una vulnerabilidad crítica de ejecución remota de código en PHP. Demuestra el potencial de agentes IA en security research, aunque también subraya riesgos de mal uso.
bajada_en: Researchers used AI to discover a critical remote code execution vulnerability in PHP. Demonstrates AI agents' potential in security research, though also highlights misuse risks.

title: ChatGPT Ads expands to 26 new countries as over 100,000 advertisers have used the platform
summary: From local businesses to global brands, more advertisers can now reach people as they explore, compare and decide what to buy in ChatGPT.
title_es: ChatGPT Ads expande a 26 nuevos países
bajada: OpenAI expandió ChatGPT Ads a 26 nuevos países con más de 100,000 anunciantes activos. Muestra tracción comercial en publicidad integrada dentro de ChatGPT como canal nuevo para negocios.
bajada_en: OpenAI expanded ChatGPT Ads to 26 new countries with over 100,000 active advertisers. Shows commercial traction in integrated advertising within ChatGPT as a new business channel.

title: Meta says Muse has over 10M users, with shopping a top activity
summary: Meta Muse users are adopting the app for shopping and personal productivity, the company said during Q3 earnings. The AI app now has over 10M users.
title_es: Meta Muse alcanza 10M usuarios con enfoque shopping
bajada: Meta reportó que Muse superó 10 millones de usuarios, con shopping como actividad principal. Indica adopción significativa del agente IA de Meta y consolidación de compras como caso de uso dominante.
bajada_en: Meta reported Muse surpassed 10 million users, with shopping as the primary activity. Indicates significant adoption of Meta's AI agent and consolidation of shopping as the dominant use case.
